sox_new_high_before_deadline.question_text: {deadline_label} 이전에 PHLX Semiconductor Index(^SOX) 일봉 종가가 {reference_date}까지의 역사적 최고 종가(동 CSV 기준)를 엄격히 초과한 거래일이 한 번이라도 있는가?
sox_new_high_before_deadline.resolution_criteria: {market_csv_rel} (^SOX Yahoo Finance). reference_high = max(Close) for rows with Date <= {reference_date}. Window: {window_start} <= Date <= {window_end} (NYSE 거래일). TRUE if any Close > reference_high. All window closes <= reference_high => FALSE. CSV unavailable or reference_high undefined => VOID.
sox_new_high_before_deadline.source_detail_template: [HYPO] Logos {motif_lanes} + pack={pack_id}; melt-up before Dan.5 weigh; [NON_GATING]; B-rail.

sox_daily_drop_ge_pct_window.question_text: {drop_window_label} US/Eastern 거래일 중 ^SOX 일간 수익률이 −{drop_pct}.00% 이하(하락 {drop_pct}%p 이상)인 날이 한 번이라도 있는가?
sox_daily_drop_ge_pct_window.resolution_criteria: {market_csv_rel}. Daily return (Close_t/Close_{t-1}−1) <= −{drop_pct_decimal}. on any row with Date in {drop_window_start}..{drop_window_end}. TRUE if >=1 day. FALSE if none. VOID if >=5 consecutive missing rows in window.

sox_close_below_ref_minus_pct.question_text: {deadline_label} 이전에 ^SOX 종가가 ({reference_date}까지 CSV 역사적 최고 종가 대비 {drawdown_pct}% 이상 하락한 수준, 즉 Close <= {drawdown_multiplier} * reference_high)으로 마감한 거래일이 한 번이라도 있는가?
sox_close_below_ref_minus_pct.resolution_criteria: {market_csv_rel}. reference_high = max(Close) for Date <= {reference_date}. Threshold = {drawdown_multiplier} * reference_high. Window {window_start}..{window_end}: TRUE if any Close <= threshold. FALSE if all Close > threshold. VOID if reference_high undefined.
sox_close_below_ref_minus_pct.source_detail_template: [HYPO] Logos Rev.18/Babylon hub + Dan.2:43 iron_clay; pack={pack_id}; [NON_GATING]; B-rail.
